initiativeFormula.name: Initiative Formula
initiativeFormula.hint: Combat tracker formula: Dexterity modifier, initiative adjustments, and decimal tie-breaker.

initiativeTiebreaker.name: Initiative Tie-Breaker
initiativeTiebreaker.hint: Adds the decimal Dexterity score (DEX / 100) to initiative to break ties automatically.

maxHpFirstLevel.name: Maximum Hit Points at Level 1
maxHpFirstLevel.hint: New heroes receive the maximum hit points for their first level.

encumbranceTracking.name: Encumbrance Tracking
encumbranceTracking.hint: Applies the SRD optional carrying-capacity rule and its penalties for excess weight.

collapseItemCards.name: Compact Chat Cards
collapseItemCards.hint: Shows item rolls and activations in a compact format to save chat space.

learningMilestones.name: Milestone Advancement
learningMilestones.hint: Allows level advancement through story milestones instead of accumulated XP.

criticalHitRule.name: Critical Hit Rule
criticalHitRule.hint: Method used to calculate damage on critical hits.

deathSaveDC.name: Death Saving Throw DC
deathSaveDC.hint: Difficulty for death saving throws (the standard 5e value is 10).

diagonalMovement.name: Diagonal Grid Movement
diagonalMovement.hint: Rule used to count diagonal movement on the grid.

primaryParty.name: Primary Party
primaryParty.hint: Group actor used to calculate encounter difficulty.

Wizard.Title: Chronicle of Awakening
Wizard.RollModeHint: Point limits were ignored for this journey.
Wizard.SkillInfo: Select skills to gain Proficiency Bonus (+{bonus}).

Steps.IdentityIntro: Every legend starts with a name. How will the bards sing your glories?
Steps.BioPlaceholder: Where did you come from? What event brought you to adventure?
Steps.RaceIntro: Ancestry defines your basic instincts, attribute bonuses and innate abilities.
Steps.ClassIntro: Class defines your combat abilities, feats and spell progression.
Steps.AbilitiesIntro: Distribute your points to define your hero's physical and mental capabilities.
Steps.SkillsIntro: Choose the skills your character is trained in (Proficient) according to your Vocation.
Steps.SpellsIntro: As a caster, you must choose your starting spells.
Steps.NoSpells: No spells available for your class at level 1.
Steps.LanguagesIntro: Based on your Intelligence and ancestry, you can choose additional languages. You selected {count} of {max} available.
Steps.LanguagesHint: Additional languages represent your character's erudition and ability to communicate across different cultures.
Steps.ReviewIntro: Review your chronicle before awakening your hero to the world.
Steps.FinalWarning: “Once the journey begins, fate is drawn.”
Steps.FinalHint: Ensure all details are correct. By proceeding, the hero will awaken.

LevelUpWizard.Title: Chronicle of Ascension
LevelUpWizard.ConfirmationNotice: Do you confirm the awakening of these new capabilities?

Step1.HPRollDesc: Your Constitution Modifier will be added automatically.

Step2.Title: Attribute Improvement
Step2.Description: Choose an attribute to increase by +1.

Step4.Description: Choose your new feats based on your Progression Tree.

Step5.Title: ARCANE KNOWLEDGE

Step7.Title: ASCENSION REVIEW
Step7.ConfirmationNotice: Upon confirming, these changes will be permanently applied to the character.
